column1: # WGSL. Rule: every module-scope declaration is a definition. fn is function,
# struct is class, alias is type_alias, const/let/override are constant, and a
# module-scope var (uniform, storage, private, workgroup, handle) is variable.
# Struct members, parameters, function-local const/let/var, enable and requires
# directives are not definitions. A function is on its fn line, the attributes
# above it are not part of the line.
